# Project Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup

source('https://inkaverse.com/setup.r')

library(googlesheets4)
library(dplyr)
library(factoextra)

```

# Data import

```{r}

gs <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/15r7ZwcZZHbEgltlF6gSFvCTFA-CFzVBWwg3mFlRyKPs/edit?gid=172957346#gid=172957346"

fb <- read_sheet(gs, sheet = "fb") %>%
  mutate(
    irrigation = factor(irrigation),
    genotype = factor(genotype),
    block = factor (block),
    replication = factor (replication)
  )

str(fb)


```

# Bloxplot

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

ggplot(fb, aes(x = genotype, y = hi, fill = irrigation)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(
    x = "irrigation",
    y = "genotype"
  ) +
  theme_classic()
```

## Modelo estadistico

$$y=  \mu + block + genotype + irrigation + genotype*irrigacion + error$$

# ANOVA

```{r}
md <- aov(tubdw ~ block + genotype + irrigation + genotype*irrigation, fb)
anova(md)

plot(md)
```
## Comparacion de medias

```{r}

mc_i <- md %>% 
  emmeans(~ irrigation | genotype) %>% 
  cld(Letters = letters, reversed = TRUE) %>% 
  mutate(across(".group", trimws)) %>% 
  mutate(across(".group", tolower)) %>% 
  rename(sig_i = ".group")

mc_o <- md %>% 
  emmeans(~ genotype | irrigation) %>% 
  cld(Letters = letters, reversed = TRUE) %>% 
  mutate(across(".group", trimws)) %>% 
  mutate(across(".group", toupper)) %>% 
  rename(sig_o = ".group")

mc <- merge(mc_i, mc_o) %>% 
  unite(col = "sig", c("sig_i", "sig_o"), sep = "")
```

## Grafico

```{r}
mc %>% 
plot_smr(type = "line", x= "genotype", y = "emmean", group = "irrigation", sig = "sig", sigsize = 2, error = "SE")
```

# Multivariate

```{r}

#| eval: false

library(factoextra)
library(gridGraphics)

dtx <- fb %>% 
  dplyr::select(!c("block", "replication")) %>% 
  group_by(irrigation, genotype) %>% 
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>% 
  unite("rowname", c("irrigation", "genotype"), remove = F, sep = "-") %>% 
  column_to_rownames() %>% 
  as.data.frame()

str(dtx)
  
mv <- dtx %>% 
  PCA(scale.unit = T
      , graph = F
      , quali.sup = c(1, 2))

var <- mv %>% 
  plot.PCA(choix = c("var"), cex=0.7)

cos <- mv %>% 
  fviz_pca_var(col.var = "cos2"
               , gradient.cols = inti:::paleta()
               , repel = TRUE
               , labelsize = 2)

ind <- mv %>% 
  plot.PCA(choix = c("ind")
           , cex = 0.7
           , label = "ind"
           , invisible = "quali"
           , col.hab = inti:::paleta()
           , habillage = "1"
           )

pcainfo <- factoextra::get_pca(mv); pcainfo

pcainfo$cor %>% kable(caption = "Variable correlations")
pcainfo$contrib %>% kable(caption = "Variable Contribution")
pcainfo$cos2 %>% kable(caption = "Variable Cos2")

cls <- mv %>% HCPC(nb.clust = -1, graph = FALSE)

map <- \() {plot.HCPC(cls, choice = "map", draw.tree = FALSE)}

cls$call$t$tree
cls$data.clust %>% 
  kable(caption = "Cluster membership of each individual")  
cls$desc.var$quanti %>% 
  kable(caption = "Quantitative variables characterizing each cluster")
cls$desc.var$category%>% 
  kable(caption = "Categorical variables significantly by cluster")  
table(cls$data.clust$clust) %>% 
  kable(caption = "Number of individuals assigned to each cluster")

plot <- list(var, cos, ind, map) %>% 
  plot_grid(plotlist = ., ncol = 2, labels = "auto") %>% 
  ggsave(plot = ., "manuscript/multivariate.jpg", units = "cm"
                , width = 30, height = 30)

plot %>% include_graphics()
```

## PCA information

```{r}
c1 <- fviz_eig(mv, 
                addlabels = TRUE,
                hjust = 0.05,
                barfill="white",
                barcolor ="darkblue",
                linecolor ="red") + 
  # ylim(0, 30) +
  labs(
    title = "PCA - percentage of explained variances",
    y = "Variance (%)") +
  theme_minimal()  +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12)
    , axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12)
  )

c1

c2 <- fviz_contrib(mv,
                     choice = "var", 
                     axes = 1, 
                     top = 30,
                     fill="white",
                     color ="darkblue"
                   , sort.val = "asc"
                   ) +
  # ylim(0, 8) +
  labs(title = "Dim 1 - variables contribution", x = "") +
  coord_flip()  +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12)
    , axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12)
  )

c2

c3 <- fviz_contrib(mv,
                     choice = "var", 
                     axes = 2, 
                     top = 30,
                     fill="white",
                     color ="darkblue"
                   , sort.val = "asc"
                   ) +
  # ylim(0, 8) +
  labs(title = "Dim 2 - variables contribution", x = "") +
  coord_flip()  +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12)
    , axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12)
  )

c3

lpanel <- c(c1, c2, c3) %>% 
  plot_grid(plotlist = ., ncol = 1, labels = "auto"
            , rel_heights = c(1, 1.2, 1.2))
  
rpanel <- \() {
  
pcainfo$cos2[, 1:2] %>% 
  corrplot :: corrplot(
    is.corr = F
    , method = "number",
    type = "full",
    tl.col = "black",
    tl.srt = 45,
    tl.cex = 0.9, 
    number.cex = 0.5, 
    number.digits = 1,
    cl.cex = 0.7,
    cl.pos = "r",
    cl.align = "r",
    cl.ratio = 4 
  )

}

grid <- c(lpanel, rpanel) %>% 
  plot_grid(plotlist = ., ncol = 2, labels = c("", "d"))

plot <- grid %>% 
  ggsave(plot = ., "manuscript/contribution.jpg"
         , units = "cm"
         , width = 28, height = 36)

plot %>% include_graphics()
```
